newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues sees Lyonnaise telecom deal-paper.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues sees Lyonnaise telecom deal-paper.

text.p: French construction group Bouygues is ready to bring utilities company Lyonnaise des Eaux into a joint venture used to hold Bouygues' interests in fixed telecommunications, the newspaper Les Echos said on Friday.

Bouygues currently has 51 percent and Italy's STET 49 percent in the venture, which is the vehicle for its hopes to be France's third global operator after France Telecom and Cegetel, the Generale des Eaux telecoms joint venture.
"For the French part, Bouygues plans to welcome Lyonnaise des Eaux and perhaps EDF (Elctricite de France)," the report said. Germany's Veba could also enter the telecoms venture.

Bouygues hopes to bring in Germany's Veba into the Bouygues-STET joint venture with a stake of up to 20 percent and STET dropping down to 29 percent, the newspaper quoted Bouygues Telecom chief executive Philippe Montagnon as saying.
